snippet.title: Tidebreak | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The storm is coming. Send it back.

Tidebreak is a single-player arcade shooter where daring dashes turn enemy fire into a devastating Return Volley. Fly through seven stages, face multi-phase bosses, and uncover a mystery through voiced radio conversations.

Take on the campaign, practice boss encounters, or challenge the Boss Rush. Choose from Rookie, Arcade, and Ace difficulty settings as you fight your way through the storm.

Out now on PS5 and  Nintendo Switch.

#Tidebreak #ArcadeShooter #ShootEmUp
